title: Single amino acid variation in MAB21L1 is dominantly associated with congenital eye defects.
authors: Meng, Fanlei; Li, Xin; Zhang, Jinlu; Gao, Zhiyang; Yang, Xue; Liu, Ziqi; Liu, Yajie; Guo, Tong; Wang, Likun; Yang, Liping; Wang, Zhaohui
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AlphaFold2预测MAB21L1突变体结构并结合细胞/果蝇实验研究先天性眼缺陷，虽涉及蛋白结构预测但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Diagnosis of a genetic disease and determination of the causative molecular lesion rely on the availability of the disease-associated pedigrees. Microphthalmia is a congenital eye defect due to an insufficiently developed visual system; its prevalence is 1-3 in 10 000 live births. OBJECTIVE: We analysed a pedigree exhibiting autosomal dominant inheritance of microphthalmia to determine the genetic lesion; used AlphaFold2 to predict the changes in the protein's 3-Dimensional structure; and compared wild-type and variant proteins in cultured cells or Drosophila model was used to explore the cellular or developmental function of the encoded product. RESULTS: We identified a novel missense variation, F52L, in MAB21L1 that is absent in population databases and present exclusively in the individuals diagnosed with microphthalmia in this pedigree. Common structural changes were predicted for the disease-associated variants clustered at amino acids 49-52, and these variant products were also predominantly trapped in the cytoplasm of cultured human lens epithelia. To recapitulate its dominant effect in development, we expressed the Drosophila homologue corresponding to MAB21L1(F52L) and caused malformation of sensory organs. CONCLUSION: Mutations at the residues 49-52 of MAB21L1 compromise eye development. We recommend including MAB21L1 in the genetic testing panel for congenital eye disorders.
abstract_zh: 背景：遗传病的诊断及致病分子病变的确定依赖于疾病相关家系的可用性。小眼症是一种因视觉系统发育不全导致的先天性眼部缺陷；其患病率为每10,000名活产婴儿中1-3例。目的：我们分析了一个表现出小眼症常染色体显性遗传的家系，以确定遗传病变；使用AlphaFold2预测蛋白质三维结构的变化；并在培养细胞或果蝇模型中比较野生型与变异蛋白，以探索编码产物的细胞或发育功能。结果：我们在MAB21L1中发现了一个新的错义变异F52L，该变异在群体数据库中不存在，且仅存在于该家系中被诊断为小眼症的个体中。预测疾病相关变异聚集在氨基酸49-52位点，并导致共同的结构变化，这些变异产物也主要被困在培养的人晶状体上皮细胞的细胞质中。为了在发育中重现其显性效应，我们表达了与MAB21L1(F52L)对应的果蝇同源物，并导致感觉器官畸形。结论：MAB21L1第49-52位残基的突变损害眼部发育。我们建议将MAB21L1纳入先天性眼部疾病的基因检测组合中。
